work.description: DCCXLV: whole Ubi primum eight-clause constitution, first-person restoration/negotiation proem, complete incorporated fourteen-article convention and Consalvi/Blacas signatures LF50827–51062, papal resumption/ratification, warning, legal/transumpt/sanctio and full datum LF51185–51190. Retains its contemporary citations LF50812–50813. Exact XML leaf379 has own heading/protocol at right LF50617–50632 and own incipit/body at right LF50687; intervening left-column LF50635–50684 is the preceding separately printed convention’s ending, excluded. Whole remaining body follows normal L/R through leaves380–383. The incorporated convention is retained as part of this complete papal act, not stripped as duplicate. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
work.title: Confirmatio conventionis cum Ludovico XVIII rege Francorum
